description: Portugal weather forecast — official IPMA 5-day forecast for a Portuguese city: Lisbon, Porto, Faro, the Algarve, Madeira (Funchal), Azores (Ponta Delgada). Returns daily min/max temperature (°C), precipitation probability, weather description in English, and wind direction/strength. Example: ipma_forecast({ city: "Lisboa" })

city.description: Portuguese city or island, e.g. "Lisboa", "Lisbon", "Porto", "Faro", "Funchal", "Ponta Delgada". Accent-insensitive; use ipma_locations to browse all 35.
